newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials lower at open on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials lower at open on Wall Street.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average fell along with bonds in early trading on Wednesday, coming in for some profit-taking after a rally in the final hour on Tuesday.
The Dow was down 17 points at 7,049, although the Nasdaq Composite was up fractionally at 1,366.
On the New York Stock Exchange advances lagged declines by 220 to 293. But on the Nasdaq, 596 issues were up and 379 down.
The 30-year long bond was down 6/32 to yield 6.56 percent.
